name: cachly
description: Persistent memory for AI coding assistants: lessons, decisions, and the causal graph your team builds up — over MCP, hosted in the EU.

plugins.name: cachly-brain
plugins.description: Your assistant forgets everything each morning. cachly remembers your system: the bug you fixed, why you chose Postgres, the deploy step that always breaks — and which earlier decision a new one contradicts. Every editor reads the same memory, and every lesson carries the name of whoever learned it.
